name: Mayvheen Ahaffa
source:
Mayvheen is a young woman [spoiler]of Jewish origin.[/spoiler]

Like most people she struggles with some anxiety from time to time, but she also has a calm and peaceful side to her.

She is well liked by most and has wisdom beyond her years.
